title: Shooting to be investigated: [FINAL C Edition]
article: There will be an independent investigation into the fatal shooting of an Alert Bay woman by police, Solicitor-General Rich Coleman said yesterday.
Lorraine Jacobson, 40, was shot by a constable Friday in her home.
The constable responded alone to a call over a domestic disturbance in the Whe la la U First Nations community.
He shot the woman when she allegedly refused to put down a knife.
